_comment: Model manifest for reproducible download. V tab owns this. ONNX files are gitignored; this manifest (name/url/sha256/size/license) is the source of truth. Verified sha256 is computed by download_models.py after fetch. Landmark model ships inside a PINTO tarball, so its entry uses archive_url + member (see download_models.py).

face_detection_yunet.role: face detection + 5-point landmarks (both eyes, nose, mouth corners)

face_landmarks_mediapipe.source: PINTO0309/PINTO_model_zoo 410_FaceMeshV2 (ONNX port of Google MediaPipe Face Mesh V2; original model Apache-2.0)
face_landmarks_mediapipe.role: 478-point face mesh (468 face + 10 iris), x,y,z; used for EAR (eyelids), MAR (lips), head roll/pitch proxy
face_landmarks_mediapipe.note: PINTO S3 archive URL may change over time; source repo is the stable reference. Verify by sha256.

palm_detection_mediapipe.source: opencv/opencv_zoo models/palm_detection_mediapipe (ONNX port of Google MediaPipe palm detector; Apache-2.0)
palm_detection_mediapipe.role: palm bounding boxes (SSD, 2016 anchors). V7: hand-near-mouth proximity for 'drink'. No 21-pt handpose model (bbox centre suffices).
palm_detection_mediapipe.input: 192x192 BGR->RGB, scale 1/255; outputs Identity (1,2016,18) box/landmark deltas + Identity_1 (1,2016,1) score; anchors generated (vision/hands.py).
palm_detection_mediapipe.note: OPTIONAL: if absent, 'drink' is simply not emitted and the rest of vision is unaffected. Anchors are generated deterministically (verified against the official literal), not embedded.
